rules.title: The server passes prompts, it does not carry them
rules.text: `jev-lsp` renders no prompt text: the words a model reads live in the core's verb specs, so the server passes a spec and never holds an instruction of its own. A literal instruction here is a second prompt nobody versions. ARCHITECTURE §1.

inspection.pattern: (?i)"(you are|your task|you must|return (only )?(json|a json)|answer (with|in)|do not (ask|reply)|reply with)\b

judgement.question: Is this instruction text a model will read, embedded in the server, rather than a spec that `jev-core` renders?

criteria.true: the literal is an instruction addressed to a model
criteria.false: it is a type, a version constant, a comment, or a message written for a person
